title: Senate Republican leader celebrates reconciliation bill and criticizes Democrats
text:
Republicans delivered a historic reconciliation law that will make the United States safer, stronger, and more prosperous. Its investments in military readiness and border enforcement, support for American energy, permanent tax relief, and spending savings are major achievements. President Trump and Republican lawmakers kept their promises and put the country on the right path.

Democratic senators, meanwhile, have answered progress with obstruction, delay, and blockage. They refuse to cooperate even on nominees who have support from both parties. Republicans will not allow those tactics to stop the president from assembling his team or completing the agenda voters chose. The Senate majority will keep pressing forward for security, prosperity, energy dominance, lower taxes, and a more sustainable government.
source: Office of the Senate Majority Leader
label: Right
